findings.note: The Default-FAIL verification contract records two required checks as passes:false. Regression evidence explicitly says the repository regression does not pass, and placeholder evidence exits 1 without the human acceptance required by that scanner. T-002 therefore lacks a passing verification contract.

The contract explicitly states its spec_revision is stale and deliberately was not reissued after the approved specification amendments. It therefore does not bind an independent quality-gate pass to the implementation and requirements currently under review.

The supplied green evidence ends at TEST-013af, while the current suites and amended AC-027 require TEST-013ag/ah for malformed upgrade_reasons on eligible:true entries and TEST-013ai/aj for falsy-value behavior. The newest mandatory behavior has no current execution evidence in the bundle.

findings.note: The PowerShell negative test accepts any exit other than 0 or 10 for an unsupported bare second positional argument and records exit 1, while the documented usage-error convention is exit 2 and the Bash twin returns 2. The assertion does not enforce cross-runtime exit-code parity for this invalid invocation.
